description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting Salvager of Secrets.
Tura Kennerüd triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Salvager of Secrets.
Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {U}.
Repeat.
